context_for_next_testing_agent: CRM Phase 3 complete. All features working: Visual Workflow Builder (crm_workflows collection with triggers: deal_stage_changed, contact_created, deal_created, contact_tag_added, deal_value_above, no_activity_days and actions: create_task, send_notification, move_deal_stage, add_tag, create_activity, wait), CPQ Quotes (crm_quotes collection with line items, VAT 20%, GBP currency, status workflow: draft→sent→accepted), Sage 200 Integration (crm_integrations collection, MOCKED - no live API keys, sync endpoints return 503 as expected). PWA manifest accessible at /manifest.json with start_url=/crm.

mocked_apis.note: Sage 200 sync endpoints correctly return 503 when no live credentials configured. Stripe payment link endpoint requires live STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.

workflows.meta: GET /api/crm/workflows/meta - returns triggers and actions definitions
workflows.create: POST /api/crm/workflows - creates workflow with trigger and actions

cpq_quotes.list: GET /api/crm/quotes - returns quotes array with total count
cpq_quotes.create: POST /api/crm/quotes - creates quote with line items, calculates subtotal/VAT/total
cpq_quotes.get: GET /api/crm/quotes/{id} - returns single quote with all details
cpq_quotes.accept: POST /api/crm/quotes/{id}/accept - accepts quote with accepted_by name

sage200.get_config: GET /api/crm/sage200/config - returns configured status and settings
sage200.sync_pull: POST /api/crm/sage200/sync/customers - pulls customers from Sage (503 without live creds)
sage200.sync_push: POST /api/crm/sage200/sync/customers-to-sage - pushes contacts to Sage (503 without live creds)

pwa.manifest: GET /manifest.json - returns PWA manifest with name, icons, start_url=/crm
